profile.headline: Software Developer at HealthStream
profile.summary: Detail-oriented, analytical individual looking to secure a position that will utilize my exceptional problem-solving and communication skills as well as my strong computer knowledge.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
● Develop and maintain a web application for workforce compliance monitoring, ensuring adherence to industry standards.
● Build and enhance software solutions using ASP.NET Core, EF Core, and Angular to deliver scalable, high-performance applications.
● Design and extend robust APIs while seamlessly integrating external APIs to expand application capabilities.
● Collaborate cross-functionally with product and internal teams to deliver high-impact, client-centric features.
● Implement refined, accessible, and feature-rich user interfaces tailored to client requirements, improving usability and satisfaction.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
● Developed high-performing, scalable, enterprise-grade applications using REST APIs, Spring, and Spring Boot, delivering robust and efficient solutions.
● Designed and optimized complex queries for relational databases, including Oracle and PostgreSQL, to ensure data integrity and performance.
● Maintained and enhanced existing applications by implementing client-requested features and addressing performance issues, improving overall user satisfaction.

positions.title: Business System Analyst
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
● Analyzed business and system requirements using the SCRUM framework to deliver project milestones on time and enhance system functionality through collaboration with engineers.
● Created and maintained detailed documentation to support system functionality and streamline ongoing projects, improving team alignment and knowledge sharing.

positions.title: Geek Squad Agent

projects.title: Workforce Validate
projects.description: Developed a web application that identifies and prevents current and future workforce threats by enabling continuous monitoring of medical staff. The application tracks providers' licenses, certifications, state exclusions, and sanctions while offering robust reporting and data auditing capabilities. Validated over one million healthcare professionals across multiple clients.

projects.title: Application Angular Update
projects.description: Upgraded a web application from Angular 9 to Angular 17, significantly enhancing user experience with improved performance and modernized UI components. The update also resolved critical security vulnerabilities inherent in the older framework version.
